## Stage B Request

In the same instruction, the owner requested: “Let's use it to launch stage B
at xhigh effort.” The requested reasoning effort is recorded exactly as
`xhigh`.

The dispatch has not been executed because the accepted architecture requires:

```text
separately authorized quarantined method development
  -> frozen held-out qualification
  -> scientific-owner-approved qualified-method record
  -> sealed implementation-blind author packet
  -> method-specific Stage B authorship
```

No empirical lane, qualified-method record, or exclusive implementation-blind
author packet presently exists. The current `AUTHOR_PACKET_MANIFEST.md` is an
explicit non-dispatchable placeholder, and the sanitized-input proposal says a
selected recurrence and owner-approved qualified-method record are required.

Dispatching a method-specific Stage B author now would therefore contradict
the accepted claim-layer sequence and give the author no exact method to
contract. It would also silently convert the accepted architecture into a
different, framework-level Stage B task.

## Exact Resolution Required Before Dispatch

The scientific owner must choose one of two materially different actions:

1. preserve the accepted sequence and separately authorize the quarantined
   empirical-development/qualification lane that must produce a qualified-
   method record before Stage B; or
2. explicitly supersede the accepted sequence for v0.1 and authorize an xhigh
   **framework-level** Stage B author to contract only the development and
   qualification architecture while leaving every numerical method and its
   scientific performance unavailable.

After either choice, Stage A must produce and exact-byte bind the corresponding
exclusive implementation-blind author packet. A fresh xhigh author may then be
dispatched from that packet only.
